title: Boss Challenge: Outbreak Detective
summary: A cholera outbreak hits a town. Identify the disease, map the cases, find the contaminated well and stop it.

ib.note: Unit summative-style task: using evidence to solve a public-health problem (Criteria A and C)

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 3: Health: The Ultimate Treasure
Earlier NCERT Ch 2: Microorganisms: Friend and Foe

objectives: I can use a map of cases as evidence to find the source of an outbreak.
I can recommend actions to stop a water-borne outbreak.
misconceptions: Outbreaks are just bad luck, with no pattern.
